name: Pangisdaan
description: A fishing landing on the riverbank. Three villagers fish with traps (bubo) and nets from a bangka: fresh fish for the barangay, and some to trade for gold. Fishing the same waters too hard lowers the catch for a while.
sources: docs/game-design.md (cost, 3 workers, unlock at 15 villagers; gold per worker lowered from 0.2 to 0.1 by the balance pass, npm run simulate)
William Henry Scott, Barangay: Sixteenth-Century Philippine Culture and Society (Ateneo de Manila University Press, 1994)
